thread:
jamal: brief follow-up from today's regional failover run — capturing owners, short ETAs, and what to validate in the next game-day. Key observations: route-change jitter under synthetic spike, restores slowed by concurrent retention work, and runbook step ordering ambiguous for partial restores.

maria: good notes. i'll take runbook clarity and the pre-restore checklist. creating TSK-9001. ETA: Tue 09:00 UTC.

chris: i'll audit the route-weight ramp policy and health-probe windows. TSK-9002. ETA: Fri COB. will include exact gcloud/kubectl checks and rollback commands.

leo: eng-runtime will own telemetry for INC-4450 (recurring route spike). i'll add a dashboard: cross-region p95, route-weight delta, and edge 5xx rate. TSK-9003. ETA: Thu EOD.

sara: i'll own snapshot restore perf tuning and the checksum mismatch samples. TSK-9004. plan: isolated restores during low-retention activity. ETA: Mon 18:00 UTC.

jamal: ops-bot, please create a rehearsal event next week for validation (routing spike, snapshot restore, partial-region restore).

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: "DR rehearsal  routing & restore validation" Wed 2026-04-01 14:00 UTC. Invitees: jamal, maria, chris, sara, leo, eng-sre. Reminder 30m prior.

maria: for the runbook edit i'll add an explicit 'quiesce dependent services' step and a decision tree for partial vs full restore (include shard-verify).

chris: sample commands i'll run in audit:
```
gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress --region=europe-west1
kubectl -n infra get svc router-probe -o yaml
```

leo: for INC-4450 telemetry i'll need help pulling KV-cache miss counters from eng-runtime lib; tagging eng-runtime in TSK-9003.

sara: note from today's rehearsal: ~11% of partial restores had a transient checksum mismatch. mitigation: retry with shard-verify + exponential backoff. i'll add logs to TSK-9004.

jamal: summary of action items for the DR tracker:
- TSK-9001 runbook edits -> maria -> Tue 09:00 UTC
- TSK-9002 routing audit & rollback steps -> chris -> Fri COB
- TSK-9003 telemetry/dashboard for INC-4450 -> leo/eng-runtime -> Thu EOD
- TSK-9004 restore perf & checksum -> sara -> Mon 18:00 UTC

jamal: please update your tickets with a 2‑line test plan before EOD tomorrow so we can validate during the rehearsal. i'll consolidate for the weekly DR cadence doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:
